## May Angels Take You

_aka, "Reveries"; aka, "Dying Vicariously"; aka, "Autumn Angel"_

It's in moments like these where I have to ask myself, "Why'd I decided to write this?" _To force myself to do it of course._ This is a nexus where my life, travels, writings, design, and music all come together. Long-time fans of my music know the name immediately as the penultimate song we always play live before going into "Arise", which you can hear on the "[Warriors in Waiting](warriors-in-waiting-live-set)" live set. The song even has a few different production cuts, such as the "Dying Vicariously" mix ([Bandcamp](https://sanjayaprime.bandcamp.com/track/may-angels-take-you-dying-vicariously)) and the original mix itself on my hit album "[IO Vapoura \[Variations\]](io-vapoura)". It's from the music that the design on the right was born.. . although it wouldn't be the last.

On one of my journeys back home into the Yucatan, my brother Zero came with me. We'd taken respite at a library in Ciudad Victoria while waiting for the mob of federales outside to get the heck outta our way. Zero looked up from a book he was reading, and in one of his more intense moments, asked, "Why didn't you tell me your mother was a suicide goddess?"

So yeah.. . there it is. Witch, queen, goddess, demon, alien, and the third and final surviving daughter of ek'Balam himself -- Ix'Tab ek'Balam. My history with her is turbulent at best. To this day, my centuries alongside "The Hanged Woman", the jaguar priestess herself, is why Tiki calls Kan "Little Tortilla Boy" (that, and a joke made by a comedian Tiki liked).

I'm not angry at Tab anymore. I'm not angry at you. I'm still confused about our last meeting in 2004. You made it look like your own suicide, but I swear that inverted pyramid and all the organic controls.. . it could've just as easily been a ship. I guess I should expect nothing less than for you to leave me with more questions than answers.

texts: ## Reveries + Dying Vicariously When I kicked off my "[Urban Geometry](1000-swords)" series, there were three pieces I knew had to be forged as part of it: [The Lady of a Thousand Swords](1000-swords), The Father of Assassins, and Dying Vicariously... which is the final version you see above. She looks down and to her left, pulling from dreams, memories, and reveries of all that has passed. I laid out fractal feathers for her long sleep before painting over the statue herself. I tried out some autumn leaves, later scrapping the idea. Not that I've given up on it... as I'll be returning to this in a future version, likely painted and recreated from the ground up. In many ways, I've never left those last moments in 2004. _I'm still there with you._ And I'm still not 100% sure that I ever walked out of that pyramid.

## The Legacy of the Hanged Woman

A fool like me... the more I try to separate myself from you, the more proof that I am your son. Let it be said, however, that unless I'm terminally ill and in so much pain that I cannot stand on my own two legs to fight another day... up until that moment, I will not sever the thread of life by my own hands. It is there where we differ, mother.

The legacy of the hanged woman lives on as a plague throughout the Yucatan... even worse among the Maya who are my people. It is pushed by the government and the media of Mexico, who's continued stories on the suicides further amplify the Werther effect (aka, "suicide contagion"; [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copycat_suicide)). The suicide rate in my homeland is almost twice that of Mexico itself... with hanging the preferred form of exit strategy by such a large margin that it's clear there's no coincidence.

For those who don't know how suicide spreads, when a media story covers the method, it causes a spike in that exact type. The more dramatic the story, the larger the spike. Throw a celebrity in there? Or just someone well known in the community? That name-drop spikes it another 10% - 20% over the next few months. If the stories ignore the reasons and motivations, the nail's driven even further into the coffins.

Even with Ix'Tab gone from this place -- this mockery of a thing we call "reality" -- the disease itself still spreads... calling others to join her in glory itself.

With the whole of humanity on the verge of possible non-existence, _who's to say they are wrong?_

## Exploring Even Further

"May Angels Take You" is a part of the greater "[Urban Geometry](1000-swords)" series (featuring "The Lady of a Thousand Swords"). You'll find prints and other products for this design [here on Redbubble](https://www.redbubble.com/shop/ap/44341355). The "Dying Vicariously" live version of the song is on our "[Warriors in Waiting](warriors-in-waiting-live-set)" live set, with the production cut [here on BandCamp](https://sanjayaprime.bandcamp.com/track/may-angels-take-you-dying-vicariously). The original version, however, was released in production form as far back as "[IO Vapoura \[Variations\]](io-vapoura)". For more on my stories from the Yucatan... well . . that's a story for another day.
